title: Tempo Lab
user: Musicians practicing timing and expressive playback who need controlled tempo variation and repeatable drills rather than a fixed click or destructive notation hacks.
smallest_useful_product: Offline web metronome with bounded random drift, ramp, delayed-beat, and recovery drills; save/share a tiny session preset and export a practice log.
success_measure: At least 50% of weekly active beta users save and replay three or more named drills within 30 days.
constraints: Keep audio timing deterministic and functional offline; avoid medical/performance claims; provide accessible visual/haptic alternatives.
